motion-boundary.name: Motion Boundary
motion-boundary.purpose: Wrap one region with explicit enter, exit, active, and reduced-motion behavior without choreographing the whole page.

anatomy.rule: Owns the visible Motion Boundary container.
Shows idle, entering, active, exiting, reduced-motion, and disabled with separate enter, move, and exit timing.
Uses a bounded cue to reveal local transition state without becoming page choreography.

motion-boundary.statePrecedence: disabled > reduced-motion > exiting > entering > active > idle

Momentum.decision: Use Flow enter timing for entering, move timing for active transitions, and exit timing for exiting.
Momentum.behavior: Motion Boundary exposes local state without absorbing patterns.
Momentum.test: Verify entering and exiting states use separate Flow timing tokens.
Momentum.rejectIf: Entering and exiting use the same undocumented timing or route choreography is hidden in the component.

do: Use Motion Boundary for its bounded job.
dont: Page choreography, route transition systems, and animation storytelling belong to patterns or foundations.
Do not create multi-step system inside it.
Do not rely on color or motion only.
info: Escalate to patterns when orchestration appears.

agentInstructions: Use Motion Boundary only for local component behavior.

semanticDecisions.decision: Entering uses Flow enter timing; exiting uses Flow exit timing; active uses Flow move timing.
semanticDecisions.reason: Motion Boundary must make start/end behavior explicit without owning page choreography.
semanticDecisions.test: Verify computed cue transition changes between entering and exiting states.
semanticDecisions.rejectIf: Entering and exiting share undocumented timing or hardcoded motion.

semanticDecisions.decision: Motion Boundary wraps one bounded region only; choreography escalates to patterns/foundations.
semanticDecisions.reason: Multi-region timing is product orchestration, not a component concern.
semanticDecisions.test: Verify demos do not coordinate multiple regions.
semanticDecisions.rejectIf: Route/page choreography is hidden inside Motion Boundary.
